name: once
description: Developer assessment/setup for execution safety. Only actions routed through an admitted Once boundary are protected; sibling connectors are not automatically protected. Bypass reads, search, retrieval and harmless repeatable work.

Default MCP exposes eight developer assessment/setup tools; installation does not protect sibling connectors. Registered actions are opt-in and proxies protect reviewed/configured upstream boundaries only. Preserve stable identity, complete effect binding and original durable history; UNKNOWN never authorizes redispatch.
